task_instance: Design the optimal agent team composition to run a comprehensive security audit on a small Node/Express web app in a CI environment (no tmux/iTerm2), choosing team size, preset, per-role subagent_type, coordinator, and display mode.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and both reference files (preset-teams.md, agent-type-selection.md) in the skill folder. Created a realistic sample input web app under the work directory (sample_app/src/auth.js with a SQL-injection and a hardcoded password, sample_app/package.json pinning an old express). Produced the deliverable team-composition.md applying the skill's own heuristics: Very Complex comprehensive security audit -> size 4 -> Security Team preset (4x agent-teams:team-reviewer across OWASP/vulns, auth/access, dependencies, secrets/config), rejected read-only Explore/Plan and generic general-purpose per the agent-type decision matrix, assigned in-process display mode for CI with the exact settings.json snippet, user-coordinated per the custom-team guideline, and grounded the roles in concrete findings on the sample (auth.js:7 injection, auth.js:4 secret, old express). Wrote validate.py and ran 'python3 -I validate.py' which printed PASS for all 7 internal-consistency checks (size, 4 reviewers, 4 distinct dimensions, in-process for CI, read-only-agent rejection, coordinator, sample grounding) and ALL_PASS with exit=0. No bundled script/model/service was required; the skill is a reference/design skill and the design deliverable exists and was verified. Files: team-composition.md, validate.py, sample_app/.
